# RevenueHunt

> Product recommendation quizzes for Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Magento, and headless stores. Turn passive browsers into qualified buyers by guiding them to the right product through an interactive quiz funnel - and capture zero-party data for segmentation, personalization, and email follow-up.

Available in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Italian under /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, and /it/ (same page structure; see each page's hreflang tags for the translated equivalents).

## What we do

- Build product recommendation quizzes that surface the right item from a catalog of any size
- Capture zero-party data (preferences, problems, goals) - richer than analytics, owned forever
- Sync answers and recommendations to email/CRM/ads tools (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Omnisend, HubSpot, Meta Ads)
- Power AI-personalized email follow-ups based on quiz responses
- Run on every major ecommerce platform: Shopify (Built-for-Shopify certified), WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Magento, headless

- [/state-of-product-recommendation-quizzes/](https://revenuehunt.com/state-of-product-recommendation-quizzes/) - The state of product recommendation quizzes 2026: a benchmark report from 45M+ real quiz responses across 20,000+ stores. Quiz takers convert at 5.5% (1 in 18, ~2.75x a typical store), conversion by category (fragrance 6.9%, haircare 6.7%, supplements 6.2%, beauty 6.1%, coffee 5.0%, CBD 4.3%, other sectors ~3.6%), within-store AOV uplift +11-15%, 69% completion, and 1 in 5 orders landing 30+ days later. Free, ungated, downloadable PDF
- [/state-of-the-shopify-app-economy/](https://revenuehunt.com/state-of-the-shopify-app-economy/) - The state of the Shopify app economy 2026: a data report on all 22,546 live Shopify apps. The store grew ~10x since 2020 (6,000+ apps in the last 12 months); 51% have zero reviews and 74% have fewer than five; the top 1% of apps earn an estimated 72% of revenue (top 10 = 28.5%); 46.9% are free, 48.6% free-trial, only 4.5% charge up front; built in 115 countries (US 16%, India 9%), only 6.7% are Built for Shopify. Interactive charts. The thesis: building the app was never the hard part, distribution and trust is the only AI-proof move left

- [/compare/octane-ai/](https://revenuehunt.com/compare/octane-ai/) - RevenueHunt vs Octane AI (Octane AI alternative): free plan, no Shopify watermark, unlimited quizzes, from $39/mo
- [/compare/zoovu/](https://revenuehunt.com/compare/zoovu/) - RevenueHunt vs Zoovu: a focused, self-serve Shopify quiz vs an enterprise product-discovery suite
- [/compare/nosto/](https://revenuehunt.com/compare/nosto/) - RevenueHunt vs Nosto: a focused, self-serve zero-party quiz vs an enterprise personalization, search & merchandising suite
- [/compare/jebbit/](https://revenuehunt.com/compare/jebbit/) - RevenueHunt vs Jebbit: a standalone, self-serve Shopify quiz (Jebbit is now part of BlueConic's CDP)

## Glossary (quiz & personalization terms)

- [/glossary/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/) - Glossary hub: definitions of quiz and personalization terms

- [/glossary/conversational-commerce/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/conversational-commerce/) - Conversational commerce: selling through a two-way conversation, not a static grid; a quiz is its most reliable form
- [/glossary/product-discovery/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/product-discovery/) - Product discovery: how shoppers find the right product (search, filters, guided quizzes); the conversion unlock for large catalogs
- [/glossary/product-recommendation-engine/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/product-recommendation-engine/) - Product recommendation engine: the software that ranks a catalog per shopper; quiz-based engines have no cold-start problem
- [/glossary/personalized-product-recommendations/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/personalized-product-recommendations/) - Personalized product recommendations: suggestions tailored per shopper from behavior or stated preferences; works on the first visit with a quiz
- [/glossary/ecommerce-personalization/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/ecommerce-personalization/) - Ecommerce personalization: adapting the store to each shopper; a quiz is the lowest-lift entry point
- [/glossary/shoppable-quiz/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/shoppable-quiz/) - Shoppable quiz: an interactive quiz that ends in add-to-cart on the results page, not a survey
- [/glossary/quiz-funnel/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/quiz-funnel/) - Quiz funnel: a marketing funnel that uses a quiz to turn traffic into qualified, opted-in, segmented leads
- [/glossary/lead-generation-quiz/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/lead-generation-quiz/) - Lead generation quiz: captures email plus zero-party preferences as an opt-in with a built-in reason to subscribe
- [/glossary/conversion-rate-optimization/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/conversion-rate-optimization/) - Conversion rate optimization (CRO): raising the share of visitors who buy; a product quiz targets the indecision leak
- [/glossary/average-order-value/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/average-order-value/) - Average order value (AOV): total revenue divided by orders; a quiz raises it by recommending a complete set, not one product
- [/glossary/cross-selling-and-upselling/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/cross-selling-and-upselling/) - Cross-selling vs upselling: add complementary products vs trade up to a better one; a quiz builds both into the recommendation
- [/glossary/customer-segmentation/](https://revenuehunt.com/glossary/customer-segmentation/) - Customer segmentation: grouping buyers by shared traits; quiz answers become customer tags synced to Klaviyo and more
